preconditions.description: The number of stations n is between 1 and 100000.
The number of commuters m is between 1 and 100000.
The total units of Nitro K is between 0 and 10000000.
The number of distances is exactly n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 < d <= 100 for d in distances)
preconditions.description: Each distance d is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= t <= 10000000 for t, s, e in commuters)
preconditions.description: Each arrival time t is between 0 and 10000000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= s < e <= n for t, s, e in commuters)
preconditions.description: Each boarding station s and destination station e satisfy 1 <= s < e <= n.

postconditions.description: The return value is the minimal total travel time for all commuters.
